title: Billing Clause for the First Term of a VPS or Dedicated Server
content:
## Clause 1: the first-term line

The first term of a server in the VPS and Dedicated Servers range is billed at the tier's price per month for a 1-month term, or at the tier's price per month on a 12-month or 24-month term times the months, less the account tier's server discount percentage where the account discount applies to the tier's term prices, rounded half up to the cent.

Stated as a definition of the amount billed:

| Term ordered | Amount of the first-term line |
|---|---|
| 1 month | the tier's price per month on the 1-month term, multiplied by one hundred less the account tier's server discount percentage, divided by one hundred, rounded once half up to the cent |
| 12 months | the tier's price per month on the 12-month term multiplied by 12, then multiplied by one hundred less the account tier's server discount percentage and divided by one hundred, rounded once half up to the cent |
| 24 months | the tier's price per month on the 24-month term multiplied by 24, then multiplied by one hundred less the account tier's server discount percentage and divided by one hundred, rounded once half up to the cent |

The tier's three term prices and its setup fee are the figures of the tier ordered; the server discount percentage is the figure of the customer's Harborline account tier. The discount acts once, on the full term amount, and rounding happens once, on the discounted amount.

## Clause 2: the setup fee

The setup fee is billed as its own line unless the term is at least the tier's shortest term on which the setup fee is waived. Where it is billed, it is the tier's one-time setup fee, on a line of its own beside the first-term line.

## Clause 3: when the purchase lines are billed

Purchase lines are billed when the order is placed, while the server is provisioning. The evidence is the server's own status in its holding record, which shows provisioning at the moment the lines are billed.

## Hypothetical worked figures

The prices and discounts below are invented inputs, not Harborline prices.

- **12-month term:** a tier priced at a hypothetical 40.00 per month on the 12-month term, ordered by a customer whose account tier carries a hypothetical 7 percent server discount. 40.00 multiplied by 12 is 480.00; 480.00 multiplied by 93 and divided by one hundred is 446.40. The first-term line is 446.40.
- **1-month term, rounding:** a tier priced at a hypothetical 10.10 per month on the 1-month term, with a hypothetical 15 percent discount. 10.10 multiplied by 85 and divided by one hundred is 8.585, which rounds half up to 8.59.
- **No discount:** an account tier with a server discount of 0 percent pays the full term amount, rounded to the cent.

## Setup line by term length

| Term ordered | Is the term at least 12 months? | Setup fee line |
|---|---|---|
| 1 month | No | Billed, at the tier's setup fee |
| 12 months | Yes | Not billed |
| 24 months | Yes | Not billed |
